paite: Huan Ziphte Gibeah ah Saul kiang ah ahoh ua, “Gamdai chin a Hakilah mual ah David akibu kei maw?" chi in ava gen uhi.
heading: David In Saul Hinna Ahawi Nawn

paite: Huchi in Saul athou a, Ziph gamdai ah Israel mite lak a pan telkhiak mi sangthum pi in Ziph gamdai ah David zong ding in ahohsukta uhi.
Saul in gamdai chin, lampi gei suahlam a om, Jeshimon toh kigalsai, Hakilah mual tung ah panmun akhoh a, gamdai ah David a-om lai a, Saul amah zong in gamdai ah ahong chih athei hi.
Huaiziak in David in enkhe mite asawl a, huchi in Saul ahong taktak chih atheitelta hi.
David athou a, Saul panmun khohna ah ahoh hi. David in Saul leh asepaih heutu, Ner tapa Abner lupna amu hi. Giahphual um sung ah Saul alum a, akim ah mite'n a-umkual uhi.
David in Hit mi Ahimelek leh Joab unau Zeruiah tapa Abishai kiang ah, "Saul panmun ah kua ahia ka kiang a hong ding?" chi in agen hi. Abishai in, "Kei na kiang ah ka hong suk sam ding," achi hi.

Huchi in David leh Abishai mipite omna ah zan in ava hoh uhi. Ngai in, Saul bel giahphual um sung ah lum in a-ihmu hi. Alulam ah ateipi lei ah asiat tal a, Abner leh mite bel akim ah lum in a-ihmu uhi.
Abishai in David kiang ah, "Tuni in Pathian in na melma na khut a hon pia ahita ve. Huaiziak in teipi in khatvei in lei ah ka hon sunden suk ding aw? Nihvei sut tuan angai kei ding," achi hi.
Himahleh David in Abishai kiang ah, "Hihmangthang ke'n, TOUPA thaunilh tung a khut kha amoh lou kua a-om thei a?" achi hi.
David mah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. TOUPA'N atung ah khut kha na ve. Ahihkeileh leng asih ni ahong tung na ding. Ahihkeileh leng, kidouna ah ahoh dia, amangthang mai ding.
TOUPA thaunilh tung ah khut ka kha het kei ding. Alu kiangchin a teipi leh tuithawl ahihleh la inla, pai ni," achi hi.

Huchi in David in Saul lu kiangchin a teipi leh tuithawl ala a, apai nawnta uh. Kuamah in amu kei ua, kuamah in phawk in akhanglou kei. TOUPA'N nuamtak a a-ihmutsak ziak in avek un nakpi in a-ihmu uhi.
Huchi in gal khat lam ah David ahoh a, gamla kuam ah mualvum ah adingh a; akikal uh gamlapi ahi.
David in mipite leh Ner tapa Abner zak in akikou a, "Abner, na hon dawng kei dia hia?" chi in asam hi. Huchi in Abner in adawng a, "Kumpipa sam nang kua na hia?" achi hi.
David in Abner kiang ah, "Mihangsan na hi kei maw? Israelte lak ah nang bang kua a-om a? Bangchidan ahia kumpipa, na toupa na ven louh? Kumpipa, na pu hihmang ding in kuahiam khat ahong pai hi.

Na thilhihdan ahoih kei. TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. TOUPA thaunilh toupa na ven hoih louh ziak in si dia kilawm na hi. Kumpipa lu chin a teipi leh tuithawl om koi a om ahita ua? En him dih," achi hi.
Saul in David aw athei a, "Tua nang aw hia, ka tapa David?" achi hi. David in, "Hi, toupa, kumpipa aw, ka aw ahi,” achi hi.
"Bangziak in ahia ka toupa in asikha adelh? Bang thil ka hih a ahia? Akhut ah thil gilou bang ahia om?

Huaiziak in toupa, ka kumpipa'n asikha thu ngaikhia hen. Kei dou dia na lungtang tokthoupa TOUPA ahihleh thillat pom teitei hen. Mihing tate ahih uleh TOUPA ah hamsia thuak in om uhen. Pai inla, pathian dangte nna sem in, chi a TOUPA gou ka luah theihlouhna dia tuni a hon delhmang lah ahi ngal ua.
Huaiziak in TOUPA muh phak louh in lei ah ka sisan luang kei hen. Vengkeng gem dia tang a mi agamvak bang un Israel kumpipa, uihik leltak zong ding a paikhia ahi ve," achi hi.

Saul in, "Ka na khialta. Ka tapa David, hong pai nawn in. Tuni a na mitmuh a ka hinna amanphat mahmah ziak in bangmah himhim ka hihta kei ding hi. Ngai in, thil haihuai mahmah ka na hihta a, ka nak khelh mahmah hi,” achi hi.
David in adawng a, "Toupa aw, teipi en dih, tangval khat hong henla, hong la hen.
TOUPA'N michih adiktat man uleh amuanhuai man uh ape ding. Tuni in TOUPA'N ka khut ah nang ahon pe na a, TOUPA thaunilh tung ah ka khut ka lik nuam kei a ahi.
Ngai in, tuni a na hinna ka hon mantamsak mahmah bang in TOUPA'N ka hinna hon mantamsak henla, mangbatna tengteng a pan hon hunkhia hen,” achi hi.
Huchi in Saul in David kiang ah, "Ka tapa David, vualzawl in om in. Thilhihtheitak in na om dia, na zou zel ding," achi hi. Huchi in David apai a, Saul leng amun ah apai nawnta hi.
